body:
## Story Points: 5 | Priority: P0 | Sprint: 2

## Summary
Record vehicle exit, calculate fee from active rate schedule and elapsed time, release slot.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] POST /api/v1/parking/exit accepts ticketId and paymentMethod
- [ ] Customer can only exit their own session (403 otherwise)
- [ ] Ticket not found returns 400; already-completed returns 403
- [ ] Fee = max(0, durationMinutes - gracePeriod) * ratePerHour / 60, rounded HALF_UP to 2 decimal places
- [ ] Duration within grace period yields zero fee
- [ ] Slot released to AVAILABLE after exit
- [ ] GET /api/v1/parking/history returns own completed sessions for CUSTOMER
- [ ] GET /api/v1/parking/history/vehicle/{id} enforces ownership

## Tests
ParkingServiceTest (fee calc, grace period, ownership, double-exit)

## Definition of Done
Fee calculated correctly; slot released; history endpoint scoped to authenticated user.
